title: Ads keep Flap Fit free
body:
Google AdMob uses app and device information, IP address and approximate location, diagnostics, and ad interactions to deliver non-personalized ads. RevenueCat measures ad loads, views, clicks, and revenue using a separate random app ID and app/device information. Neither receives your camera footage, recordings, exercises, scores, or training history.

Continue to acknowledge this notice, or review it in Privacy & choices.
